scope: Size exploration and parameter selection before the numeric rank and span optimizations; timeouts are not proofs of infeasibility.

results.scope: Blank normal magic squares; first solution, no constructive solution hints. Timings include model setup but exclude import and validation. Repeats are deterministic runs of one problem, not separate instances.

preset_before_update.scope: Empirically selected first-solution settings for blank normal magic squares; not optimality guarantees or settings for clued puzzles.

preset_after_update.scope: Empirically selected first-solution settings for blank normal magic squares; not optimality guarantees or settings for clued puzzles.
preset_after_update.default_basis: Extrapolated from 9x9 and 10x10. No verified winner yet for 11-13 or 15-20.
